topNews.text: Endangered California Condor Flies into Oregon for the First Time in 122 Years
topNews.excerpt: Last month, a California condor flew into Oregon before returning after several hundred miles to its home in Redwoods National Park, becoming the first condor recorded in the state since 1904. Taking a closer look, condor conservationists among northern California’s Yurok tribe concluded it was condor B9, an animal that had been born in captivity
topNews.creator: Andy Corbley
